finding: Existing C02 foundational claims C012-C014 justify base-ten written addition/subtraction, multiplication and long division for whole-number/integer representations. C02-N002-C010 allows decimal place alignment, but there is no explicit foundational claim explaining written arithmetic for terminating decimals. Formal field operations on Q/R cannot substitute for the place-value written-method progression required by G02.
residual_missing_meaning: place-value-based written methods for multi-digit terminating-decimal addition/subtraction/multiplication/division
expected_developmental_role: Extend whole-number place-value algorithms coherently across the decimal point so learners understand decimal written methods as scaled base-ten arithmetic rather than decimal-point placement rules by rote.
proposed_minimal_repair: Append two atomic claims: finite-decimal addition/subtraction via common place-value scaling, and finite-decimal multiplication/division via integer scaling with tracked powers of ten. Supersede foundational objective N003-FLO-003 to explicitly include terminating decimals.
duplicate_risk_check: LOW: C02 owns mathematical arithmetic methods; B1.5 retains implementation/runtime, and C10 retains numerical-analysis error/stability rather than school arithmetic algorithms.
next_action: Apply minimal C02 decimal-method repair, re-test G02, then continue semantic-atom regression for G03-G09.
